supporting_observations.claim: The outbound HTTPS attempts are consistently associated with C:\Program Files\GradeBookPro\gradebookproupd.exe running as raul.diaz and connecting through the organization's proxy to update.gradebookpro.com.
The observed attempts recur at roughly five-minute intervals from 13:38:54 through 14:08:46 UTC, consistent with the inventory's stated GradeBook Pro updater check cadence.
The proxy records show successful tunnels as well as one denied attempt and one gateway error; the records do not establish that every attempt completed successfully.
The executable, destination, and cadence match the approved GradeBook Pro updater behavior described in the environment context, supporting a benign disposition for this alert.

known_telemetry_limitations: Winsec collection on DC-ORC-01 was unavailable from 13:30 to 14:20 UTC, according to the supplied sensor status; this limits domain-controller event visibility during the review window.
The supplied proxy records identify HTTPS CONNECT destinations and outcomes, but do not expose the contents of successful TLS tunnels.
The supplied records do not establish the updater executable's signature, integrity, or the authenticity of any update content.
claims_not_established: The contents or authenticity of data exchanged in successful HTTPS tunnels are not established.
The evidence does not establish that the updater downloaded or installed an update.
The evidence does not establish the executable's signature or integrity.
